loop_2310A.name: Referring Provider Name
loop_2310A.conditional: Required when this claim involves a referral. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send. First iteration NM101=DN; second iteration (when used) NM101=P3.

nm101.name: entity_identifier_code
nm101.description: DN=Referring Provider (first/only iteration), P3=Primary Care Provider (second iteration only)

nm104.name: referring_provider_first_name
nm104.conditional: Required when the person has a first name. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

nm105.name: referring_provider_middle_name
nm105.conditional: Required when the middle name or initial is needed to identify the individual. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

nm107.name: referring_provider_name_suffix
nm107.conditional: Required when the name suffix is needed to identify the individual. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

nm108.name: identification_code_qualifier
nm108.conditional: Required when the provider has an NPI available to the submitter (see X222 NM108 situational rule). If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
nm108.description: XX=NPI; paired with NM109 via P0809

nm109.name: referring_provider_identifier
nm109.conditional: Required under the same situational rules as NM108. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
nm109.description: NPI when NM108=XX; paired with NM108 via P0809

REF.name: Referring Provider Secondary Identification
REF.conditional: Required prior to the mandated NPI date when an identification number other than NPI is necessary; OR on/after NPI date when NM109 of this loop is not used and an identifier other than NPI is necessary. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n402.conditional: Required when the address is in the United States of America, including its territories, or Canada. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
